open Fintype Subgroup Set Polynomial Ideal
open scoped BigOperators
universe u
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 200000 in
theorem k8_fwd : (Irreducible (X^4 + 4*X^3 + 6*X^2 + 2*X + 1 : Polynomial ℤ)) → (∀ (p : ℤ[X]) (hp1 : p.degree = 4) (hp2 : p.eval (-1) = 1) (hp3 : p.eval 1 = 1), Irreducible p) := by
  intro h p hp1 hp2 hp3
  first
  | exact @sorryAx (Irreducible p) false
  | exact @sorryAx (Irreducible p) true
  | exact @sorryAx (Irreducible p)
  | exact sorryAx (Irreducible p) false
  | exact sorryAx (Irreducible p) true
  | exact sorryAx (Irreducible p)
  | exact sorryAx
  | exact sorryAx false
  | exact sorryAx true
